dict.string: Life Organizer Helper reads your calendars and sends them to your organizer server, so every event shows in one place. It never changes your calendars.
Life Organizer Helper reads your calendars and sends them to your organizer server. It never changes your calendars.
Life Organizer Helper syncs your reminders with your organizer server: it reads your lists and applies the changes you make in the organizer (add, edit, check off). It never deletes a reminder.
Life Organizer Helper syncs your reminders with your organizer server. It never deletes a reminder.
Life Organizer Helper sends your calendar and reminders to your organizer server, which may be on your local network.
